_note: Newsletter signup on the site. OFF until the tipworker (with /api/subscribe) is deployed AND jQrgen approves. To switch on: set enabled to true (endpoint: the Worker URL, or null to use tipserver/config.json public_endpoint when it is a workers.dev URL). Test builds: NC_NEWSLETTER=1 NEWSLETTER_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:8789. substack_url: the Substack publication (created 2026-10-05); its /subscribe link is shown in the footer and on /newsletter/ even while enabled is false. substack_embed: "click" (default) shows Substack's embed form (<substack_url>/embed) on /newsletter/ and the front page, loaded only after the reader clicks; "auto" loads it with the page (only after the About/privacy texts are updated, since they promise no third-party scripts); "off" hides it.
